findings.finding: Existing CX-R20 machine gate already passes but is pinned to the older v2 backend projection map and a 40cb9e7-era acceptance freeze.
findings.resolution: Preserve v1 artifacts as historical evidence and establish v2 current-main contract plus v4 projection map.

findings.finding: Current R2 successor projection map v3 adds current/future CX boundaries but no longer carries the explicit FDR/FCR/FAR/HFP Financial Reality mapping present in v2.
findings.resolution: v4 merges predecessor evidence and explicitly restores Financial Reality runtime coverage without moving authority into CX.

findings.finding: The original seven adapters do not expose reusable standalone JR continuity or PR/PFR professional-review projections.
findings.resolution: Add consume-only Continuity and Professional Review adapters; neither is activated as a product by R20.

findings.finding: Readout and nested Reality reading projections default missing upstream state to AVAILABLE.
findings.resolution: Missing upstream state now remains UNKNOWN; adapter may not upgrade availability.

findings.finding: Financial projection defaulted missing currency to MYR, which can create an unsupported customer fact.
findings.resolution: Currency now remains null unless supplied by runtime snapshot or customer intake.

findings.finding: Priority customer APIs already consume projection adapters rather than returning raw runtime objects.
findings.resolution: Preserve these API boundaries and freeze them as prerequisites for R10/R12/R13/R9-R2 successor work.

findings.finding: PRE-R20 correctly preserved the additive Personal Reality CSS hotfix, but the active PPR current shared-owner registry still pointed to the predecessor CSS digest.
findings.resolution: Advance only the active current-owner digest to the audited current CSS SHA, record the predecessor digest, and add required hotfix tokens; CSS bytes remain unchanged.

preserved: Personal Reality CSS bytes at audited current-main hotfix state
